## 简体中文

### 亮点

- 新增一等 Mihomo 支持，包括平台感知的软件包选择、校验、运行控制和 Clash Meta 配置渲染。
- 新增订阅集、自定义节点、来源诊断、节点追踪和工具箱转换流程。
- 围绕 ACME 组件库重做 Web 控制台，改进订阅编辑与运行诊断。
- 新增参数化一行安装、便携/系统部署控制以及统一的本地开发命令。

### 修复

- 修复便携运行分发，并隐藏不可用的 Web UI 操作。
- 改进订阅编辑器布局、模态框行为、来源调试状态切换和开发 API 代理。
- 恢复跨平台发布冒烟测试以及诊断中的自定义节点可见性。

### 验证

- 通过 Linux、macOS、Windows 测试、原生服务冒烟测试、Go 竞态检测、govulncheck、Mihomo 1.19.29 冒烟测试和响应式网站检查。

- [完整更新记录](https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0)

## English

### Highlights

- Adds first-class Mihomo support with platform-aware package selection, validation, runtime control, and Clash Meta rendering.
- Adds subscription sets, custom nodes, source diagnostics, node tracing, and Toolbox conversion workflows.
- Reworks the Web console around the ACME component library with improved subscription editing and runtime diagnostics.
- Adds parameterized one-line installation, portable/system deployment controls, and a unified local development command.

### Fixes

- Fixes portable run dispatch and hides unavailable Web UI actions.
- Improves subscription editor layout, modal behavior, source debug transitions, and dev API proxying.
- Restores cross-platform release smoke coverage and custom-node visibility in diagnostics.

### Verification

- Passed Linux, macOS, and Windows tests, native service smoke tests, Go race detection, govulncheck, Mihomo 1.19.29 smoke tests, and responsive website checks.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tinymins/sempre/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
